summary.text: Mark Gillen is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 128 who has served since December 1, 2010 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. His professional background includes work as an educational director and as a correctional officer.

paragraphs.text: Mark Gillen earned a bachelor's degree from Bob Jones University and a master's degree in education from Kutztown University.

His professional experience includes working as a field representative for Wilds of the Rockies Camp in Colorado, as a correctional officer, and as the educational director for the Salt and Light Foundation.
Gillen also served as a Berks County jury commissioner and on the Mohnton Borough Council.
For the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists Gillen as chair of the House Veterans Affairs & Emergency Preparedness Committee.
